main_text.p: catio irae Dei.Metonymia est,quādo dicit gladium inebriatum : ac si diceret Deum inebriatum ira, & inde commotum, tanquam is qui in ebrietate in furorem actus est. Aedom, pro omnibus gentibus impijs, per synecdochen: sicut ipse quoq; interpretatur,adijciens de uniuerso populo, qui est in anathemate. Hinc clarius exponit atrocitatem irae & uindictae Dei,depingendo per hypotyposin gladium Dei ammodo cruentatum, atq; adipe hinc inde oblinitum ex cæde procerum & tyrannorum,quos per agnos,hircos & arietes mactationi destinatos intelligit. Scitè autem alludens ad rationem sacrificiorum,ait, non aliter mactari ad interitum ac damnationem æternam impios & tyrannos omnes in Bozra (quæ celebris est Idumææ in Arabia civitas) atq; in uniuersa terra Aedom, quàm solent mactari agni,hirci,arietes in publicis sacrificijs. Descendentq; unicornes cum eis:id est,trucidabuntur siue magni,siue parui,eodem modo,quo bestiæ & ferae noxiæ solent sine ulla misericordia trucidari.
Est enim dies ultionis Domini.) Ratio repetita, quia Dominus decreuit hoc tempore iudicium suum seuerissimè exercere.
Et conuertentur flumina.)Tertia amplificatio,ab eo quòd post temporales poenas subituri sint adhuc poenas æternas,quæ per sulphur & picem perpetuò ardentes signantur.

page.notes: Single text column, no marginal notes and no footnotes. The line-end hyphen in "amplifi-" is printed, so it is kept as a catchword. "Scitè" and "ferae" are read from the grave and cedilla marks on the scan and may be slightly off. The "magni" at the line break in "ma / gni" has no printed hyphen, so it is written whole. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout. "seuerissimè" is read as printed.
